title: 登录机械指挥官
description: 填写网页登录账号。凭证只保存在本机，连接时通过请求头发送。
description_en: Enter your web login. Credentials stay on this device and are sent as request headers.

fields.label: 租户 ID
fields.description: 账号只有一个租户时可以不填。多个租户时填写要进入的租户 ID。
fields.description_en: Leave empty when the account has one tenant. Enter the tenant ID when it has several.
